author: JDeiTwo
body: So, I don't know if anyone remembers me anymore, but I am a person who got banned from this server many months ago. The Reason was that I hacked. The hack was apparently called "Spider". Since that day I have been wondering that why does your system ban players even though they try to explain that the reason they have been banned is not correct. Just like I do. I have written several of these messages even if you it doesn't help. As I have always said I didn't hack and I would appreciate if you unbanned me. Thanks for reading.

title: REMEMBER ME?!??

replies.author: Iron
replies.body:
Since you were banned such a long time ago I have decided to appeal you! Welcome back to Avicus, try not to hack again..

Thanks,
Iron.
